instructions: Log in to your Shopify admin panel and navigate to Settings > Checkout.
Click on 'Customize checkout' and select the 'Additional information' section from the left-hand menu.
Scroll down to the 'Return reasons' section and click on the 'Add return reason' button.
Enter a name for your new return reason in the 'Name' field, then add any additional details or instructions as needed in the 'Description' field.
Once you've created your return reason, navigate back to the Shopify theme editor by clicking on 'Online Store > Themes > Actions > Edit code'.

roadmap.title: Risk Remediation
roadmap.description: Address the 1 HIGH-severity risk(s) identified in the risk register before any Agent 2 executor output goes live.

recommended_ai_agents.name: Loop Returns
recommended_ai_agents.what_it_does_here: Returns management platform for Shopify merchants that converts refunds into exchanges. When a customer initiates a return, Loop suggests alternative products, different sizes, or store credit. Directly reduces refund leakage for fashion brands with high size-related return rates. Provides structured returns data as a byproduct.

recommended_ai_agents.name: Klaviyo + Mailchimp dual deployment
recommended_ai_agents.what_it_does_here: Not a single tool but a strategy: running primary email flows in Klaviyo while maintaining a Mailchimp backup list ensures no single marketing automation vendor holds all customer communication. Both export subscriber lists in standard CSV — satisfying Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 portability requirements.
recommended_ai_agents.estimated_monthly_cost_gbp: Mailchimp free up to 500 contacts. Klaviyo free up to 250 contacts

roadmap.title: Activate Built Executor Outputs
roadmap.description: Go live with the 1 opportunity(ies) Agent 2 has already built and connected.

recommended_ai_agents.name: Lyro by Tidio
recommended_ai_agents.what_it_does_here: AI agent for Shopify stores that handles order status, returns, and product questions. Critically for adoption risk, Lyro trains on your existing FAQ and knowledge base in under 10 minutes and improves from human agent responses — meaning staff see it as a tool that learns from them rather than replacing them. Smart escalation to human agents when needed.

recommended_ai_agents.name: Minami AI
recommended_ai_agents.what_it_does_here: Purpose-built for fashion and apparel brands. Autonomous operations agent covering returns, exchanges, sizing issues, and post-purchase workflows. Claims to replace up to 95% of support workload in fashion brands. Built around fashion-specific pain points so staff onboarding is faster than general-purpose tools.
recommended_ai_agents.estimated_monthly_cost_gbp: Pricing on request — positioned for mid-size fashion brands
